identity: Existing OCB extended in-place at #foldLagLens. No new canonical identity or relation.

contract.interpolation: linear turn between stations; ±70° sine hinge excursion
contract.lag: Fourth independent wing only, clamped at start, integer 0..7 synthetic slices, default 3; no cyclic wrap.
contract.geometry: Four independent rigid panels around local radial hinges; not continuous origami.
contract.reference: Fixed screen-plane white cross; positive rotations CCW.
contract.shadow: Model z=0 parallel projection followed by same view transform; no physical lighting.
contract.echo: Synthetic pose outlines 3 and 6 prior slices; separately derived from shadow.
contract.z: Synthetic sequence index, not spatial depth or physical time and not LIFE08 generation.
contract.clock: Owner-requested view-only playback: one local 400ms interval advances synthetic slices 0..28, stops at end, pause/resume and replay. First play starts at 0. Manual changes, Q4-follow or hidden tab pause. Host interlocks pause Q4 on view play and view playback on Q4 play. Source tick is never advanced by the view timer. Optional read-only Q4 mapping remains round(tick*28/15).
contract.reflection: Horizontal y negation; double x/y negation equivalent to a half-turn in model plane. No 77 law.
contract.export: Current pose, options, Q4 readout and all 29 synthetic poses, reconstructible with snapshot().
contract.return: No return claimed at 7° or 175°. Reset is view-only.

arithmetic.noInference: R/T=8/7 is not 64/64; no selector, canonical Family or scientific result is rebound.
